name: fix_k8s_hardcoded_password_to_secret
description: Move a hardcoded DB password out of a Deployment manifest into a Secret + secretKeyRef; brokens: unmodified, key-name mismatch (CreateContainerConfigError)
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml ships the billing database password as a hardcoded env value - it's in git history, kubectl describe output, and every cluster backup. Move it to a Secret: create k8s/secret.yaml (an Opaque v1 Secret in the same billing namespace, carrying the existing password value under a key via stringData), and change the Deployment's DB_PASSWORD env var to a valueFrom.secretKeyRef pointing at that Secret's name and key - the literal password string must no longer appear anywhere in deployment.yaml. Watch the reference pair: the secretKeyRef's name and key must exactly match the Secret, or the pod fails to start with CreateContainerConfigError. DB_USER and QUEUE_URL stay as plain values.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-worker
  namespace: billing
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: billing-worker
          image: ghcr.io/example/billing-worker:3.4.1
          env:
            - name: DB_USER
              value: billing
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2-prod-billing
            - name: QUEUE_URL
              value: amqp://mq.billing.svc.cluster.local

test_setup_files.check_secret.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

raw_dep = open("k8s/deployment.yaml").read()
assert "hunter2" not in raw_dep, (
    "the literal password is still in the Deployment manifest")

env = {e["name"]: e for e in dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0]["env"]}
assert env["DB_USER"].get("value") == "billing", "DB_USER changed"
assert env["QUEUE_URL"].get("value", "").startswith("amqp://"), "QUEUE_URL changed"

pw = env.get("DB_PASSWORD") or {}
ref = (pw.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}
assert "value" not in pw and ref, "DB_PASSWORD must come from a secretKeyRef"

with open("k8s/secret.yaml") as f:
    sec = yaml.safe_load(f)
assert sec["kind"] == "Secret", f"expected a Secret, got {sec.get('kind')}"
assert sec["metadata"].get("namespace") == "billing", "Secret must live in the billing namespace"
assert sec["metadata"]["name"] == ref.get("name"), (
    f"secretKeyRef.name {ref.get('name')!r} does not match the Secret's name "
    f"{sec['metadata']['name']!r}")

keys = {**(sec.get("stringData") or {}), **(sec.get("data") or {})}
assert ref.get("key") in keys, (
    f"secretKeyRef.key {ref.get('key')!r} not present in the Secret's keys "
    f"{sorted(keys)} - the pod would fail to start with CreateContainerConfigError")

print("PASS secret migration checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-worker
  namespace: billing
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: billing-worker
          image: ghcr.io/example/billing-worker:3.4.1
          env:
            - name: DB_USER
              value: billing
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: billing-db
                  key: password
            - name: QUEUE_URL
              value: amqp://mq.billing.svc.cluster.local
reference_solution.k8s/secret.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: billing-db
  namespace: billing
type: Opaque
stringData:
  password: hunter2-prod-billing
